name: Waldschlösschen Bridge
facts: The Waldschlösschen Bridge, opened on 24 August 2013, was the first European structure to be delisted from UNESCO’s World Heritage list after its construction in 2009.
Designed by engineers Eisenloffel & Sattler and architects Kolb & Ripke, the bridge won an open competition in 1997 and was built by PERI GmbH.
A 2005 public referendum approved the bridge, yet a 2007 court ruling halted construction to protect the endangered lesser horseshoe bat, only to resume later that year.
